r36_r37_decision.r37_treatment_vs_control_test: treatment test_R@10=0.1078 < control test_R@10=0.1086 (Δ=-0.0008), but Δ CI95=[-0.0015, 0.0031] CROSSES ZERO → NO STATISTICALLY SIGNIFICANT DIFFERENCE. McNemar chi2=0.38 < 3.841 → NULL hypothesis (no difference) NOT REJECTED.

r36_r37_decision.verdict: INVALID: GW signal cannot be distinguished from noise on 24772 paired samples. Mechanism is correct (Gate 1 PASS) but effect size is null.
